definitions.explanation: To physically separate something by cutting.
To separate things or concepts that were previously connected.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}と{私生活|しせいかつ}を{切|き}り{離|はな}す。
examples.english: To separate work and private life.

examples.japanese: この{問題|もんだい}は{切|き}り{離|はな}して{考|かんが}えよう。

notes:
{切|き}り{離|はな}す means to cut off and separate, either physically or figuratively.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を for the thing being separated

COMPOUND VERB:
Formed from {切|き}る (to cut) + {離|はな}す (to separate/release).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- AをBから{切|き}り{離|はな}す: to separate A from B
- {仕事|しごと}と{私生活|しせいかつ}を{切|き}り{離|はな}す: to separate work and private life
- {切|き}り{離|はな}して{考|かんが}える: to consider separately
- {切|き}り{離|はな}せない{関係|かんけい}: inseparable relationship

ASPECT (ている):
{切|き}り{離|はな}している indicates an ongoing state of separation.

PASSIVE:
{切|き}り{離|はな}される: to be cut off, to be separated
